issue_context.title: Shortcuts don't work if Alt is pressed before Shift
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:**
3.2.1.stable.official


**OS/device including version:**
Microsoft Windows [Version 10.0.17134.706]


**Issue description:**
A shortcut that uses both the <kbd>Shift</kbd> and <kbd>Alt</kbd> modifiers does not trigger its associated action if <kbd>Alt</kbd> is pressed before <kbd>Shift</kbd>.


**Steps to reproduce:**
Using the default shortcut mapping for _Quick open_, press <kbd>Alt</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>O</kbd>, in that order.


**Minimal reproduction project:**
N/A
comments:
Additionally I'm unable to create a new binding that uses both these modifiers if I press <kbd>Alt</kbd> before <kbd>Shift</kbd>. I believe that issue would be solved by fixing this one, which is why I haven't created an issue for that.
If you press Ctrl+Alt+Shift+S in this order everything works. Please rename this to "Shortcuts don't work if Alt is pressed before Shift and Control isn't used"
The difference seems to be that when you press the SHIFT key first, the window messages look like this:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/9115235/84063483-66668b00-a9c1-11ea-9030-725909623b86.png)

While in the second case the messages look like this:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/9115235/84063528-78e0c480-a9c1-11ea-8f04-f7747e23f9ba.png)

Notice the VK_SHIFT in the second case beeing a `WM_SYSKEYDOWN`. The code does not handle this case. It only sets `shift_mem` on `WM_KEYDOWN` messages.

review_comments: Should the same be done for `VK_CONTROL` below?

I think you're probably right.  I was only fixing the bug that was mentioned in the issue, but I assume that shortcuts involving control/alt might result in the same bug.  I will make that change and update the pull request.
